# Copilot Instructions

Before making any file edits, commits, or preparing a Pull Request, read and strictly follow `AGENTS.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

In particular, **execute `AGENTS.md` Section 0 first**: check whether `.bdsa-contrib-notice-shown` exists in the repository root; if it is missing, pause before editing any files, present the one-time contributor rules notice, ask the user to confirm whether the work is for personal use or an open `pr-welcome` issue, and create `.bdsa-contrib-notice-shown` once confirmed.
